'''Reom''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] and the [[President/Legends|president]] of [[IsoTech]], a black-market tech operation. He hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to track down the [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']], a missing [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]], and bring its cargo to his base on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].

==Equipment==
Reom often wore jumpsuits and dark gray cloaks, common attire for the locales he frequented. He was equipped with a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], a [[Tool kit/Legends|tool kit]], and a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]], and was armed with a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] and a [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]]. He was accompanied by his pet, a [[Bogwing/Legends|bogwing]] named [[Mordekai]].
